component.name: XL-View
component.summary: HDR image viewer for large images

description.p: XL-View is a native HDR still-image viewer for Linux, Windows, and macOS. It targets JPEG XL and handles large images such as panoramas.

ul.li: HDR output: present images through BT.2100 PQ on HDR displays or sRGB on SDR displays. HDR images are tone-mapped when they exceed the display's available brightness range.
Accurate color: preserve HDR and color profile information through the image-processing pipeline
Responsive large-image viewing: open panoramas and other large images without blocking the UI, with smooth panning
Sharp scaling: high-quality resampling for a detailed view
Image cache and preloading: keep recent images in memory and preload adjacent files for faster browsing
Metadata overlay: inspect image, output, and EXIF details without leaving the viewer
Exposure adjustment: brighten or darken an image to inspect highlights and shadows
Selectable backgrounds: assess contrast, edges, and transparency on different backgrounds
Display diagnostics: show a test pattern and runtime/display information

description.p: XL-View uses Vulkan and requires a native Wayland session. There is no X11 fallback. HDR output additionally requires an HDR-capable display and compositor HDR and Wayland color-management support.

description.p: This release switches to a faster JPEG XL decoder, adds support for linear HDR images, and improves HDR tone mapping.

ul.li: Switched to the jxl-rs decoder, making JPEG XL decoding up to 3x faster
Added support for linear images, including scRGB
Improved HDR tone mapping by using the peak brightness measured from the image instead of relying only on its metadata
Fixed the AppImage failing to launch when run by a different user, such as inside Firejail
Updated dependencies and documentation, and extended CI checks to Windows and macOS

description.p: This release improves support for large images, macOS integration, and image panning ergonomics.

ul.li: Increased the automatic decoder memory limit to support larger images
Added macOS Finder support for opening .jxl files via double-click or Open With
Improved mouse panning and double-click handling, preventing drags from being interpreted as double-clicks

description.p: This release adds native macOS support and improves HDR rendering with application-side tone mapping.

ul.li: Added macOS support with an Apple silicon DMG build
Added application-side tone mapping for more consistent HDR and SDR output
Improved HDR output handling across Linux, Windows, and macOS

description.p: This release adds Windows support and includes improvements to image navigation, resampling performance, and HDR output handling.

ul.li: Added native Windows support, including installer and portable builds
Added touchpad gestures for panning and pinch-to-zoom (Linux only)
Improved image resampling performance
Improved HDR output selection and HDR-to-SDR tone mapping
Updated packaging, diagnostics, dependencies, and documentation

description.p: First public release: an HDR image viewer for JPEG XL files on Linux, with smooth panning of large images, preloading of neighboring files, and an EXIF overlay.
